title: NIST WebBook: Ethanol gas-phase standard enthalpy of combustion
summary: The WebBook lists 1 gas-phase standard enthalpy of combustion row(s) for Ethanol. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of combustion rows for Ethanol (CAS 64-17-5) print: -1366.3 ± 0.4 kJ/mol, method Cm, reference Rossini, 1932, comment: Flame Calorimetry; Corresponding Δ f Hº gas = -278.20 kJ/mol (simple calculation by NIST; no Washburn corrections); ALS (experimental or compiled row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
